name: Warp
description: Warp allows you to securely send files to each other via the internet or local network by exchanging a word-based code. The best transfer method will be determined using the “Magic Wormhole” protocol which includes local network transfer if possible. Features - Send files between multiple devices - Every file transfer is encrypted - Directly transfer files on the local network if possible - An internet connection is required - QR Code support - Compatibility with the Magic Wormhole command line client and all other compatible apps
